data.name: Whey Protein Concentrate 80%
data.source_report: USDA AMS Dairy Market News, report 1053 (weekly whey narrative)
data.excerpt: Regular WPC 80% demand is stable to softer, with pricing from the mid $11s to the upper $12s but widening due to lower interest and increased offerings.
